en.title: [Undergraduate - Off-campus Scholarship] 2026 Second Semester Nonsan City Scholarship Foundation Scholar Selection Guide
summary: Announcement of 2026 second-semester scholar selection by the Nonsan City Scholarship Foundation ((재)논산시장학회)
Support amount: 1.5 million KRW (living expense-type scholarship)

Application venue: Nonsan City Hall Population & Youth Education Division, Education Support Team (Nonsan City Scholarship Foundation), submitted in person or by registered mail; the student or parent may apply

Eligibility: 2026 freshmen at domestic regular universities (including 2-year colleges) (신입생), born on or after January 1, 2003, who have not exceeded 5 years since high school graduation as of the announcement date, have had continuous resident registration (주민등록) in Nonsan City for at least 1 year (either the student, father, or mother), and did not apply in the first half of the year
See the attached files and the foundation's website for required documents and further details
en.easyExplanation: The Nonsan City Scholarship Foundation is selecting scholarship recipients for the second semester of 2026. Freshmen (신입생) entering domestic regular universities (including 2-year colleges) in 2026 who have had resident registration in Nonsan City for at least 1 year and who did not apply in the first half of the year may apply. Applications must be submitted in person or by registered mail by 6:00 PM on October 30, 2026 (Friday).
en.target: 2026 freshmen (신입생) at domestic regular universities (including 2-year colleges), born on or after January 1, 2003, who have not exceeded 5 years since obtaining a high school diploma as of the announcement date, and for whom the student, father, or mother has had continuous resident registration (주민등록) in Nonsan City for at least 1 year (from before September 29, 2025 through the application date) as of the announcement date (September 28, 2026). Limited to freshmen at domestic universities, industrial universities, universities of education, and junior colleges under Article 2 of the Higher Education Act. Applicants who applied in the first half of the year are excluded.

author: 김소라

originalContent:
2026학년도 하반기 (재)논산시장학회 장학생 선발 안내
1. 신청 기한 : ~ 2026. 10. 30. (금) 18:00
2. 지원내용 : 150만 원 (※생활비성 장학금)
3. 지원 자격
가. 2026년도 국내 정규대학교(2년제 전문대 포함) 신입생
나. 2003년 1월 1일 이후 출생자 중 공고일 기준 고등학교 졸업 학력 취득 후 5년이 경과되지 않은 자
다. 학생 본인, 부, 모 중 어느 한 명이라도 공고일(2026년 9월 28일) 기준 논산시에 계속하여 1년 이상(2025년 9월 29일 이전 ~ 신청일 현재) 주민등록을 둔 자
※「고등교육법」 제2조 중 국내의 대학, 산업대학, 교육대학 및 전문대학의 신입생에 한함
※ 기타 특수한 경우 재단법인 논산시장학회 이사회를 통해 결정
라. 상반기 미신청자
4. 구비 서류 : 붙임 참조
5. 접수처 : 논산시청 인구청년교육과 교육지원팀 (논산시장학회)
※ 방문 접수 또는 우편 접수(등기우편만 가능)
※ 본인 또는 부모 신청가능
6. 문의처 : 논산시청 인구청년교육과 교육지원팀 (041-746-5771)
구비 서류 및 일정 등 자세한 내용은 재단 홈페이지 및 붙임 파일을 참고하시기 바랍니다.
★ 장학복지팀 공식 인스타그램 : 인(仁)스타_장복이
